ABOUT THE COLLEGE
JANAPRIYA COLLEGE is located at Baniarapara, Barpeta district of Assam. It is an Arts college offering bachelor's degrees in various disciplines to students of both rural and urban areas. Janapriya College is a co-educational, residential and self-financing institution. It is situated in the town of Baniarapara, near the banks of the Brahmaputra River, in the district of Barpeta. The College is located at an elevation of about 1400 feet above sea level offering numerous opportunities for students from all walks of life to pursue their studies in an environment conducive to overall development. ADMISSION PROCEDURE
Application for admission into the courses begin with the notification issued by the Principal immediately after the announcement of respective results. Prospectus for admission can be obtained from the College Office on payment of the prescribed fee and the intending candidates are required to submit the completed Application Forms within prescribed time limit. Application are processed and finalized by the ‘Admission Committee’.
